item.title: US envoy 'not certain' military aid to Israel will end this year as Trump promised
item.description:
By Alexander Cornwell

TEL AVIV, Nov 24 (Reuters) - US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has cast doubt on whether Washington would end its $3.8 billion in annual military aid to Israel by the end of this year, as promised by President Donald Trump on the day of this month's midterm elections.

In his surprise announcement as voters headed to the polls on November 3, Trump said he had made a deal with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu several months earlier to stop providing Israel with around $4 billion in annual US funding.

item.title: Israeli airstrikes kill at least six Palestinians in Gaza, medics say
item.description:
CAIRO, Nov 24 (Reuters) - Israeli airstrikes killed at least six Palestinians, including two police officers, in the Gaza Strip on Tuesday, local health and police officials said.

Medics said three people were killed in an Israeli airstrike at a police post in Khan Younis in southern Gaza. The Hamas-run interior ministry said two of those were police officers.

Five other people were wounded in the attack, medics added. Later on Tuesday, medics said another Israeli airstrike near the Netzarim corridor further north killed another three people.

item.title: Iraqi PM orders ministry to manage oilfields in areas under Kurdish control
item.description:
By Muayad Hameed and Tala Ramadan

BAGHDAD, Nov 24 (Reuters) - Iraq's prime minister has ordered the federal energy ministry to manage oilfields in areas under Kurdish security control, potentially worsening long-standing tensions between Baghdad and the semi-autonomousKurdistan region after he tried to rein in an influential pro-Iranian militia.

item.title: Trump to meet NATO chief ​Mark Rutte on Wednesday, White House says
item.description:
By Kanishka Singh

WASHINGTON, Nov 23 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump will meet NATO chief Mark Rutte on Wednesday in Florida, the White House said on Monday, with the meeting coming after the Republican leader met Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese leader Xi Jinping last week in Asia.

• The White House said Trump and Rutte will meet late in the afternoon on Wednesday in Palm Beach, Florida.

• Trump, who has been critical of America's Western allies, cast both Putin and Xi as his "friend" when he met them last week at a summit.

item.title: US eyes Iran as possible culprit in dozens of new cyberattacks against ships, WSJ reports
item.description:
Nov 23 (Reuters) - The United States is investigating Iran's potential involvement in dozens of cyberattacks against energy tankers amid concerns that Tehran is widening the war with cyber operations and terror plots against Americans far from the Middle East, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.

As many as 50 ships carrying oil, liquefied petroleum, chemical products and other explosive substances are believed to have been attacked, the Journal said, citing US officials and others familiar with the matter.

item.title: Iran carries out flogging of singer and her team, Iranian website says
item.description:
DUBAI, Nov 23 (Reuters) - An Iranian singer and four members of her production team have each received 74 lashes after being sentenced for "offending public decency by producing and publishing obscene and immoral content online", an Iranian news website said on Monday.

Parastoo Ahmadi and the four others were also handed two-year bans on artistic and musical activities and travel, the Emtedad website quoted lawyer Mostafa Nili as saying.

item.title: US imposes sanctions on dozens linked to Iran's shadow banking networks
item.description:
By Andrea Shalal

WASHINGTON, Nov 23 (Reuters) - The Trump administration has issued new Iran-related sanctions targeting dozens of people and entities, the Treasury Department said on Monday, stepping up its effort to isolate Iran from the global economy and disrupt its shadow banking networks.

Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) also released an analysis identifying nearly $15 billion of financial activity conducted from January 2025 to August 2026 that it said was potentially linked to Iranian shadow banking.
